title: Computer Vision Engineer
description: A specialized AI roadmap for image/video processing, OpenCV, deep learning vision models, annotation, deployment, and portfolio projects.

tree.name: Python, Images, and OpenCV
tree.description: Start with Python, NumPy arrays, image formats, color spaces, filters, contours, camera input, and OpenCV workflows.

resources.title: OpenCV Course - Full Tutorial with Python (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: Python, NumPy, and Matplotlib
children.description: Manipulate arrays, plot images, debug pipelines, and create clean notebooks for experiments.

children.name: Image Processing
children.description: Use thresholding, edge detection, contours, morphology, histograms, feature matching, and camera calibration.

tree.name: Deep Learning for Vision
tree.description: Train and fine-tune neural networks for classification, detection, segmentation, and tracking.

resources.title: Deep Learning for Computer Vision with Python and TensorFlow (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: Classification and Object Detection
children.description: Build datasets, augment images, train models, evaluate precision/recall, and visualize predictions.

children.name: Annotation and Datasets
children.description: Label images, manage train/validation splits, detect label noise, and version datasets.

children.name: Practice: Dataset Quality Audit
children.description: Inspect labels, lighting, class imbalance, failure cases, and evaluation metrics before model training.

tree.name: Video, Deployment, and Portfolio
tree.description: Run models on images, video streams, APIs, edge devices, and build demos that prove real-world usefulness.

children.name: Video and Tracking
children.description: Process video streams, track objects, smooth detections, measure FPS, and handle latency.

children.name: Project: Vision App
children.description: Build a document scanner, attendance system, defect detector, or traffic counter with evaluation and demo video.

tree.name: MLOps, Edge, and Responsible Vision
tree.description: Prepare vision models for production with versioning, monitoring, edge optimization, and ethical evaluation.

children.name: Edge Optimization
children.description: Export models, benchmark latency, reduce size, quantize carefully, and test on CPU/GPU/edge hardware.

children.name: Bias, Drift, and Monitoring
children.description: Measure dataset bias, false positives, false negatives, lighting failures, privacy risk, and production drift.
